verdict.rationale: 1Password Service Accounts let you restrict which vaults and Environments a machine credential can reach and which actions it can perform, which is a scoped, least-privilege credential. The Credential Broker adds short-lived access for machine workflows, and the vendor positions this as delivering only authorized credentials to AI agents. missing for 10: detailed docs on per-agent token issuance, expiry and revocation mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent least-privilege use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You control which vaults and Environments are accessible and which actions the service account can perform.
Use the 1Password Credential Broker to give CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, without managing service account tokens.
Verify AI agents and machine workloads at runtime, then deliver only the credentials each is authorized to receive.
